weather_source.source_identity_reason: documented as bit-for-bit identical to source ECMWF ERA5 values

point_mapping.event_cell: event latitude/longitude rounded to nearest 0.25 degree before ERA5 lookup

local_day_aggregation.timezone: timezonefinder timezone_at() on original event coordinates
local_day_aggregation.hourly_interval_assignment: assign each 1-hour accumulation to local calendar date using interval midpoint valid_time - 30 minutes
local_day_aggregation.hourly_to_daily: sum tp * 1000 to mm by local calendar day
local_day_aggregation.small_negative_handling: values in [-1e-8,0) set to 0; any value < -1e-8 fails closed
local_day_aggregation.missing_hour_handling: any missing/nonfinite required hourly value fails closed

rainfall_metric.definition: count consecutive complete local calendar days immediately before eventDate with daily precipitation <1 mm; stop at first wet day; cap at 30

response.outcome: 1 if >=2 distinct expert-validated scientificName records share eventID; else 0

model.formula: multi ~ dry_z + C(state) * C(month) + year_z + sin_hour + cos_hour
model.support_rule: beta dry_z < 0, two-sided cluster-robust p < 0.05, and 95% CI excludes 0
sensitivities: coordinate uncertainty <=10 km with same cell clustering
full frozen sample clustered by recorder

prohibited_changes: no sample redefinition after weather values are opened
no weather-source switch based on validation result
no replacement of NAAMP primary by FrogID
